head_commit.message:
fix(hia): bound scalar native pump costs and qualify full v14 language

Reject non-integer, negative and parent-exceeding pump durations in completed and failed attempts; preserve the original 1 ns-call counterexample. Update the expanded scalar witness assertion to 832 and regenerate the pinned support identity.

Retain 23 scalar tests, 18 full native-language tests (910 internal checks, 832 scalar witnesses), and 258 unique integrated tests with no skips. Preserve original red results and setup failures. General proofs, cold/new-head CI, adoption/provider costs and NDU economics remain HOLD.
